items_flat.title_en: OpenAI cuts GPT-5.6 Sol API and credit pricing by over 20% for three months
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 將 GPT-5.6 Sol API 與點數價格調降逾 20%，為期三個月
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI announced it is dropping API and credit pricing of GPT-5.6 Sol by over 20% for the next three months. The reduction applies to the API and eligible ChatGPT Work and Codex credit plans; Pro, Plus and Business subscription usage limits remain unchanged.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 宣布未來三個月將 GPT-5.6 Sol 的 API 與點數價格調降逾 20%。降價適用於 API 及符合資格的 ChatGPT Work、Codex 點數方案；Pro、Plus 與 Business 訂閱使用額度維持不變。
items_flat.analysis_en: The temporary cut lowers the cost of frontier agent and coding workloads on the flagship model without altering subscription caps, potentially accelerating high-volume iteration while preserving recurring revenue. Sustainability after the three-month window remains an open question.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這次限時降價降低旗艦模型在代理與編碼工作負載的成本，卻不更動訂閱額度，可能加速高用量迭代，同時保留經常性收入。三個月後是否延續仍待觀察。
items_flat.quote: As we continue to push the frontier of capabilities while improving efficiency, we're dropping API and credit pricing of GPT-5.6 Sol by over 20% for the next 3 months.
items_flat.quote_zh: 隨著我們持續推進能力前沿並提升效率，我們將在未來三個月把 GPT-5.6 Sol 的 API 與點數價格調降逾 20%。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic expands Claude Mythos 5 defensive access via Claude Security and partners
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic 透過 Claude Security 與合作夥伴擴大 Claude Mythos 5 防禦存取
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic announced Claude Mythos 5 is now available in Claude Security for Enterprise customers to scan codebases and suggest patches, is being integrated into partners’ cyber tools, and launched a $35 million Defender Advantage Fund for open-source security. The Cyber Verification Program will also expand.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic 宣布 Claude Mythos 5 已可用於 Enterprise 客戶的 Claude Security，掃描程式庫並建議修補；正整合至合作夥伴網路安全工具，並推出 3500 萬美元 Defender Advantage Fund 支援開源安全。Cyber Verification Program 也將擴展。
items_flat.analysis_en: By routing Mythos 5 through constrained product interfaces rather than direct model access, Anthropic aims to scale defensive cyber capability while containing dual-use risk. Real uptake by enterprise and open-source maintainers will determine whether the approach meaningfully hardens the software ecosystem.
items_flat.analysis_zh: Anthropic 透過受限產品介面而非直接模型存取來部署 Mythos 5，意圖擴大防禦能力同時控管雙用風險。企業與開源維護者實際採用情況，將決定此作法能否實質強化軟體生態安全。
items_flat.quote: Claude Mythos 5 is now available in Claude Security, and coming soon to partners' cyber defense tools. We're also launching a $35M fund to help secure open-source software.
items_flat.quote_zh: Claude Mythos 5 現已可用於 Claude Security，並即將整合至合作夥伴的網路防禦工具。我們也推出 3500 萬美元基金協助強化開源軟體安全。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI previews Private Safety Processing compatible with Zero Data Retention
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 預覽相容於零資料保留的 Private Safety Processing
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI announced a preview of Private Safety Processing for Zero Data Retention (ZDR) customers on frontier models. The system aims to detect patterns of misuse across multiple interactions without giving OpenAI personnel access to the underlying customer content.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 宣布為零資料保留（ZDR）客戶在前沿模型上預覽 Private Safety Processing。該系統旨在跨多次互動偵測濫用模式，同時不讓 OpenAI 人員存取底層客戶內容。
items_flat.analysis_en: This attempts to reconcile enterprise privacy demands with the need for multi-turn safety monitoring as agents grow more capable. Real-world effectiveness and customer uptake will determine whether the balance holds.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此舉試圖在企業隱私需求與代理能力提升後的多輪安全監控之間取得平衡。實際成效與客戶採用率將決定此平衡能否成立。
items_flat.quote: Private Safety Processing is designed so we can continue to offer ZDR.
items_flat.quote_zh: 私密安全處理的設計是為了讓我們能繼續提供ZDR。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI launches AI Futures strategic blog on concentration-of-power risks
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 推出 AI Futures 策略部落格，聚焦權力集中風險
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI published the inaugural post of its new Strategic Futures team blog, AI Futures. The piece, by Dean Ball, frames concentration of power as the largest long-run risk from transformative AI and outlines principles for preserving individual and institutional agency.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 發布新 Strategic Futures 團隊部落格 AI Futures 的首篇文章。Dean Ball 撰文將權力集中定位為變革性 AI 最大的長期風險，並勾勒維護個人與制度能動性的原則。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is OpenAI’s most explicit public framing yet of structural political-economy risks beyond technical safety. It signals a shift toward longer-horizon institutional thinking, though concrete policy proposals remain limited.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是 OpenAI 迄今最明確公開討論超越技術安全的結構性政經風險。顯示其轉向更長視野的制度思考，但具體政策提案仍有限。
items_flat.quote: how should free society be restructured to preserve individual rights and agency while accommodating the emergence of transformative AI?
items_flat.quote_zh: 自由社會應如何重組，以在容納變革性AI出現的同時，保全個人權利與能動性？

items_flat.title_en: ChatGPT Ads expands to 31 European markets
items_flat.title_zh: ChatGPT 廣告擴展至 31 個歐洲市場
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI is expanding ChatGPT Ads to 31 European countries next week, including Germany, France, Spain and Italy. Ads remain limited to Free and Go users; paid plans stay ad-free.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 下週將把 ChatGPT 廣告擴展至 31 個歐洲國家，包括德國、法國、西班牙與義大利。廣告仍僅限 Free 與 Go 用戶；付費方案維持無廣告。
items_flat.analysis_en: The move accelerates monetization of the free tier while testing European regulatory and user acceptance. It also broadens the geographic base for advertiser demand data.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此舉加速免費層變現，同時測試歐洲監管與用戶接受度，並擴大廣告主需求數據的地理基礎。
items_flat.quote: Next week, ChatGPT Ads will expand to 31 European countries, including Germany, France, Spain, Italy, Sweden, Norway, Denmark, the Netherlands, and Austria.
items_flat.quote_zh: 下週，ChatGPT廣告將擴展至31個歐洲國家，包括德國、法國、西班牙、義大利、瑞典、挪威、丹麥、荷蘭與奧地利。

items_flat.title_en: Grok 4.6 now generally available on Amazon Bedrock
items_flat.title_zh: Grok 4.6 已於 Amazon Bedrock 正式上線
items_flat.summary_en: SpaceXAI announced that Grok 4.6 is generally available on Amazon Bedrock. The model supports a 500k context window and configurable reasoning levels, priced at $2 / $6 per million input/output tokens.
items_flat.summary_zh: SpaceXAI 宣布 Grok 4.6 已於 Amazon Bedrock 正式提供。該模型支援 50 萬 token 上下文與可配置推理等級，定價為每百萬 input/output token 2／6 美元。
items_flat.analysis_en: Bedrock availability lowers the barrier for AWS-centric enterprises to trial Grok 4.6 alongside other frontier models, intensifying multi-cloud competition for agent workloads.
items_flat.analysis_zh: Bedrock 可用性降低以 AWS 為中心的企業試用 Grok 4.6 的門檻，加劇代理工作負載的多雲競爭。
items_flat.quote: Today, we’re excited to announce that Grok 4.6 is now generally available on Amazon Bedrock.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天，我們很高興宣布Grok 4.6已在Amazon Bedrock正式上線。

items_flat.title_en: Grok Build expands to web and mobile on every plan
items_flat.title_zh: Grok Build 擴展至所有方案的網頁與行動版
items_flat.summary_en: SpaceXAI made Grok Build available on web and mobile for every plan. The coding agent previously required desktop or specific access paths.
items_flat.summary_zh: SpaceXAI 讓 Grok Build 在所有方案的網頁與行動版上線。此編碼代理先前需桌面或特定存取路徑。
items_flat.analysis_en: Broader surface availability increases everyday usage of Grok’s agent tooling and tightens the feedback loop for iterative improvements that Elon Musk has publicly emphasized.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 更廣的介面可用性提高 Grok 代理工具的日常使用，並緊密化 Elon Musk 公開強調的迭代改進回饋循環。
items_flat.quote: Grok Build is now available on every plan, on the web and on mobile.
items_flat.quote_zh: Grok Build現已在所有方案的網頁與行動版上線。

items_flat.title_en: Elon Musk highlights near-daily Grok Build improvements
items_flat.title_zh: Elon Musk 強調 Grok Build 幾乎每日改進
items_flat.summary_en: Elon Musk posted that improvements to Grok Build continue almost every day, linking to the product page after a detailed community changelog on subagent speed, workflow UX and multitasking.
items_flat.summary_zh: Elon Musk 發文表示 Grok Build 幾乎每天持續改進，並連結產品頁；社群先前已詳列子代理速度、工作流程 UX 與多工等更新。
items_flat.analysis_en: The cadence underscores xAI’s focus on agent reliability over pure benchmark leaps. Sustained daily polish may matter more for real productivity than occasional large model drops.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此節奏凸顯 xAI 更重視代理可靠性而非純基準躍升。持續每日打磨對實際生產力的影響，可能勝過偶爾的大型模型發布。
items_flat.quote: Improvements to Grok Build almost every day
items_flat.quote_zh: Grok Build幾乎每天都有改進
